format: Concatenate decoded base64 parts in listed order to recover gzip POSIX tar; paths relative to the original cohort root.
data_scope: Registered data are shared immutable inputs, not fitted checkpoints. All non-data files including failed logs, unselected checkpoints, predictions and cost receipts are in this archive. The22 original data file identities are enumerated separately; the new full rerun uses the same data seeds and cached AV source, whose resulting file identities must be checked before shared-byte reuse is claimed.
cost_scope: This local packaging body and the earlier memory backup are separate overhead; neither is training cost. GitHub transport CPU is unmeasured.
